Outdoor.title: Timeless Living &
Outdoor.desc1: Welcome to the products page of Platzhirsch Home Living – your creative space for stylish indoor and outdoor solutions. Our products combine minimalist design with craftsmanship and high-quality materials. Every piece you find here is carefully designed to be functional and to make a visual statement – whether in private homes, commercial spaces, or outdoor areas.
Outdoor.desc2: Our indoor collection offers modern furniture and accessories that highlight the character of a room without overwhelming it. From elegant shelving systems to custom seating and decorative elements – we pay attention to every detail. The clean lines, natural materials, and durable surfaces ensure that every product will inspire you today and in the future.
Outdoor.desc3: For outdoor areas, we offer stylish solutions that seamlessly connect indoor and outdoor spaces. Our weather-resistant seating, tables, and design objects not only withstand the elements, but also invite you to linger – whether on the terrace, in the garden, or in public spaces. Aesthetics and durability go hand in hand.

MarkenSection.headline: Brands
paragraphs: Our portfolio brings together an exclusive selection of renowned brands that stand for timeless elegance, exceptional craftsmanship and pioneering design. Every brand we carry tells its own story and brings its unmistakable signature to the world of design.

That range shows in every part of the home. For living and dining areas we carry upholstered furniture by Minotti, Bullfrog and Papadatos, tables and chairs by Desalto and Tonon, and design classics by ClassiCon. Rimadesio and Poliform extend the selection with storage systems, room dividers and full-glass doors that bring architecture and interior together as one.

In the kitchen and bathroom we work with next125, Schüller and Frost, alongside antoniolupi and Agape – brands that take function and material quality equally seriously. For outdoor spaces there are Gloster, Paola Lenti, Solpuri, Sifas, EMU, Tuuci and Umbrosa: furniture, parasols and textiles that keep their character after years in the open air. Heatsail extends the season into the cooler months with its patio heaters.

Lighting is a chapter of its own. With Flos, Tom Dixon, Brand van Egmond and Quasar we light rooms with intent – from restrained ambient lighting to a sculptural statement. Treca looks after restful sleep, Trapa after floors in locally sourced timber, and accessories from Eichholtz, Lambert, Pomax, Qeeboo, 101 Copenhagen, Baobab and Alonpi give every room its finishing touch.

Discover with us the variety and exclusivity of brands known internationally for their outstanding reputation. We are proud to present our customers with brands that meet the highest standards and embody the essence of luxury and innovation. In our showroom in Lochau (Vorarlberg) you can experience these brands together in one place – and our interior design consultancy helps you turn individual pieces into a coherent whole.

TeamSection.title: Learn all about us
paragraphs: A passion for exclusive brands, a keen sense for design, and a strong feeling for personality – this and more unites our amazing team. Each of us brings not only expertise and passion for what we do, but also the ability to understand and fulfill individual wishes and needs.

Our team consists of experienced professionals, creative minds, and dedicated personalities who work every day to offer you a unique experience. Together, we strive to unite the highest quality, innovative ideas, and personal consultation.

Whether it’s selecting design highlights, planning your living dreams, or realizing special projects – we’re here for you with heart and mind. For us, the focus is not only on aesthetics, but above all on the connection between people and space that we create with our work.

KarriereTeam.headline: Apply with us as a full-time or part-time team member.
paragraphs: At Platzhirsch Home Living, our mission is to fulfill the interior dreams of discerning clients with a keen sense of style, exclusivity, and quality.

We offer our clients comprehensive support from the first contact to handing over the keys – and beyond. We stand for excellent advice, bespoke solutions, and an unwavering passion for high-quality design.

Our work is based on strong values: team spirit, innovation, and the desire to always achieve the best for our clients. To realize this vision, we are looking for talented, creative, and dedicated personalities who share our passion for home culture and design.
Are you creative, experienced in kitchen planning, and want to pursue your passion for beautiful interiors?
Then you are exactly right with us!

Press.title: Platzhirsch Home Living in the press
Press.description: Press area - Always up to date. Here you will find current information, press releases and exciting news about our company, our exclusive brands and our latest projects. Whether it's product innovations, special events or collaborations with renowned partners - we keep you informed about everything that's happening with us. Our goal is to create transparency and give you a comprehensive insight into our work and our values. As a trusted source for high-quality design solutions and inspiring living ideas, we share our vision and passion with the world.Our press area is the central point of contact for media representatives, designers and anyone interested in learning more about our brand. Here we provide not only press releases but also exclusive images, additional information and detailed insights into our projects and partnerships. We place great emphasis on telling the story behind our products and projects. Our press work reflects the passion and creativity that distinguishes our company, and we look forward to sharing our journey with you. If you have any questions or need additional materials, we are always happy to help.

first_section.title: About Us
first_section.subtitle: Platzhirsch Home Living – Your Design Furniture Studio in Vorarlberg, Austria
first_section.text: Welcome to Platzhirsch Home Living, your destination for exclusive designer furniture and refined interior concepts on Lake Constance. In our showroom in Lochau near Bregenz – Landstraße 9, just minutes from the German and Swiss borders – you will discover international premium brands, thoughtful interior design and personal advice at the highest level. What defines us is a passion for timeless design, craftsmanship and sustainability: every piece of furniture, every light and every accessory in our exhibition is carefully curated. Our experienced team accompanies you from the first idea through planning to delivery and installation – whether it is a single favourite piece, a complete home furnishing or an ambitious interior design project. Get to know us, explore our world of brands and let our enthusiasm for beautiful living inspire you. We look forward to welcoming you in Vorarlberg, Austria.

ausstellung.headline: Inspiration is where every interior begins.
ausstellung.desc: Every new interior starts with gathering inspiration – and that is exactly why we created our spacious showroom on Lake Constance. On our exhibition floor in Lochau we present living ideas and insights into the world of our sophisticated, largely sustainability-oriented furniture brands such as Minotti, Poliform, Rimadesio, ClassiCon, Flos, Eichholtz, Paola Lenti and Treca Paris. Selected accessories, premium wall paints, wallpapers and rugs complete the range. And best of all: here you are welcome to test-sit, test-lie and test-dream to your heart's content – at your own pace and with personal advice.
ausstellung.careerTitle: Meet the people behind Platzhirsch Home Living.
ausstellung.tourDesc1: Step into the world of Platzhirsch Home Living and experience our furniture studio in Lochau from the comfort of your home. With our virtual 360° tour you can explore our exhibition, stylish designer furniture and inspiring interior concepts – anytime, from anywhere.
ausstellung.tourDesc2: Move freely through our carefully designed spaces, take a close look at our design highlights and feel the unique atmosphere of our studio on Lake Constance. Whether you are looking for new interior ideas, want a preview of our collections or simply seek inspiration – the 360° tour is the perfect introduction to your visit in Vorarlberg, Austria.
